en.title: Asset Analysis
en.stamp: As of Tuesday, September 29, 2026. Rising real yields and widening credit spreads set the tone.
en.banner: The tape is being driven by a fast rise in the 10 year real yield to **2.90%** alongside high yield spreads widening to **302** bp, which pressures every long duration and non yielding asset at once while cash earns a real **1.83%** over core CPI.

assets.name: US Stocks
assets.one: Rising real yields and widening credit spreads are squeezing equities, though the VIX at 16 and only a 1.9 percent drawdown from the high suggest the downside is being absorbed so far.
assets.qual: bottoming, low volatility and a shallow drawdown say the selling is orderly rather than a break

factors.b: Industrial production grew only **1.4%** year over year in August.
High yield OAS widened to **302** bp from 268 bp over the last five observations.
VIX sits at **16.04**, well within its normal range.

assets.name: US Cash
assets.one: Fed funds held at 3.88 percent with a real carry of 1.83 percent over core CPI makes cash the cleanest place on the board.
assets.qual: high held policy rates plus positive real carry and a risk off tape all pay you to wait

factors.b: The fed funds effective rate has been held at **3.88%** for five straight observations.
Real carry over core CPI stands at **1.83%** with core CPI at **2.4%** year over year.
Gold fell **3.9%** over five sessions while the S&P 500 fell **1.2%**, a risk off tape that favors cash.

assets.name: Gold
assets.one: A rising 2.90 percent real yield, a firm dollar, and a price 7.5 percent below its 200 day all point against the metal.
assets.qual: real yields rising into the high twos with the dollar above trend leaves gold with no yield and no bid

factors.b: The 10 year real yield rose to **2.90%** from 2.63% over five observations.
The dollar index sits at **101.38**, which is 2.2 percent above its 200 day.
The 10 year breakeven held steady at **2.35%** across five sessions.

assets.name: Crypto
assets.one: Tight liquidity, rising real yields, and a strong dollar are dragging on bitcoin even though it holds 17.3 percent above its 200 day.
assets.qual: bottoming, the trend structure above the 200 day is intact while liquidity pressures cap the bounce

factors.b: The 10 year real yield climbed to **2.90%** from 2.63% over five observations.
The dollar index rose to **101.38** and is up **0.8%** over five sessions.
Bitcoin trades **17.3%** above its 200 day at $83,536.

matrix.r: Industrial production up 1.4% year over year
High yield OAS at 302 bp, widening from 268
10 year real yield at 2.90%, rising from 2.63
Fed funds effective held at 3.88%
Real carry over core CPI at 1.83%
VIX at 16.04
S&P 500 at 7,671, 1.9% below its 52 week high
Dollar index at 101.38, 2.2% above its 200 day
Gold 7.5% below its 200 day
Bitcoin 17.3% above its 200 day
S&P 500 down 1.2% and gold down 3.9% over five sessions

tiles.read: The 10 year real yield at 2.90 percent is high and rising fast, which is the single biggest drag on stocks, gold, and crypto right now.
The 10 year nominal yield at 5.24 percent has climbed steadily over five sessions, tightening financial conditions.
The breakeven at 2.35 percent is flat, so inflation expectations are not the story today.
High yield spreads at 302 bp have widened from 268 bp, a clear sign of risk aversion creeping into credit.
The 3 month T bill at 4.28 percent is drifting up, keeping short end cash attractive.
Fed funds effective held at 3.88 percent shows policy steady rather than easing.
VIX at 16.04 is low and calm, telling you the equity selloff is orderly so far.
The S&P 500 at 7,671 is only 1.9 percent below its 52 week high, a shallow pullback rather than a break.
Bitcoin at 83,536 dollars is slipping but still holds 17.3 percent above its 200 day, so trend structure survives.

tiles.src: Yahoo Finance, COMEX front month, September 29
tiles.read: Gold at 4,215 dollars has fallen 3.9 percent in five sessions and now sits 7.5 percent below its 200 day.
The dollar index at 101.38 is firm and 2.2 percent above its 200 day, a headwind for gold and crypto.

calcs.lab: 10 year real yield, from the nominal and the breakeven
calcs.note: Cross checks against FRED DFII10 at 2.90 percent, a gap of 1 basis points from the different observation dates.

calcs.lab: Real carry on cash, against core CPI
calcs.note: What a 3 month T bill pays after core inflation, for taking no duration and no credit risk. Core CPI is the August print.

calcs.note: Headline includes food and energy, so this is the number a household actually feels.
The 200 day line is the trend filter the framework uses for crypto.
Gold rejecting or reclaiming this line has capped every advance this cycle.

zh.title: 资产分析
zh.stamp: 截至 2026 年 9 月 29 日，星期二。 实际利率上升与信用利差走阔定下基调。
zh.banner: 行情的主导因素是 10 年期实际利率快速升至 **2.90%**，同时高收益利差走阔至 **302** bp，这同时压制所有长久期与无收益资产，而现金相对核心 CPI 的实际收益为 **1.83%**。

assets.name: 美股
assets.one: 实际利率上升与信用利差走阔正在挤压股票，不过 VIX 处于 16，且距离高点仅有 1.9% 的回撤，说明下行压力目前正被吸收。
assets.qual: 筑底中，低波动与浅回撤表明抛售有序，而非破位

factors.b: 工业产出同比仅增长 **1.4%**。
高收益 OAS 在最近五次观测中从 268 bp 走阔至 **302** bp。
VIX 处于 **16.04**，完全在正常区间之内。

assets.name: 美元现金
assets.one: 联邦基金利率维持在 3.88%，相对核心 CPI 的实际收益为 1.83%，使现金成为全场最干净的持仓。
assets.qual: 高企且维持的政策利率，加上正的实际收益与避险行情，都让等待有利可图

factors.h: 联邦基金利率水平与倾向
factors.b: 联邦基金有效利率已连续五次观测维持在 **3.88%**。
相对核心 CPI 的实际收益为 **1.83%**，核心 CPI 同比为 **2.4%**。
黄金在五个交易日内下跌 **3.9%**，标普 500 下跌 **1.2%**，避险行情利好现金。

assets.name: 黄金
assets.one: 实际利率升至 2.90%，美元走强，价格低于 200 日均线 7.5%，这些因素都不利于黄金。
assets.qual: 实际利率升向 2.90% 上方区间，美元高于趋势，黄金既无收益也无买盘

factors.b: 10 年期实际利率在五次观测中从 2.63% 升至 **2.90%**。
10 年期盈亏平衡通胀在五个交易日内稳定于 **2.35%**。

assets.name: 加密资产
assets.one: 流动性收紧、实际利率上升与美元走强正在拖累比特币，尽管其价格仍高于 200 日均线 17.3%。
assets.qual: 筑底中，200 日均线上方的趋势结构完好，但流动性压力限制了反弹

factors.b: 10 年期实际利率在五次观测中从 2.63% 攀升至 **2.90%**。
美元指数升至 **101.38**，五个交易日内上涨 **0.8%**。
比特币价格高于其 200 日均线 **17.3%**，报 83,536 美元。

matrix.r: 工业产出同比增长 1.4%
高收益 OAS 为 302 bp，自 268 bp 走阔
10 年期实际利率为 2.90%，自 2.63% 上升
联邦基金有效利率维持在 3.88%
相对核心 CPI 的实际收益为 1.83%
VIX 为 16.04
美元指数为 101.38，高于其 200 日均线 2.2%
黄金低于其 200 日均线 7.5%
比特币高于其 200 日均线 17.3%
标普 500 在五个交易日内下跌 1.2%，黄金下跌 3.9%

tiles.read: 10 年期实际利率处于 2.90%，水平高且上升快，是当前股票、黄金与加密货币最大的拖累。
10 年期名义利率处于 5.24%，五个交易日内稳步攀升，正在收紧金融条件。
盈亏平衡通胀处于 2.35%，保持平稳，通胀预期不是今天的主线。
高收益利差为 302 bp，已从 268 bp 走阔，是避险情绪渗入信用市场的明确信号。
3 个月期国库券利率为 4.28%，缓慢上行，短端现金保持吸引力。
联邦基金有效利率维持在 3.88%，表明政策稳定而非宽松。
VIX 处于 16.04，低位且平静，说明股票抛售目前是有序的。
标普 500 为 7,671，仅低于 52 周高点 1.9%，是浅回调而非破位。
